question: What harm results from reciting a mantra merely written on a leaf or taught without proper transmission?
premises: A mantra may be merely written on a leaf.
A mantra may be merely taught without proper transmission.
Recitation of such a mantra can produce harm.
inference: Reciting a mantra obtained only from a leaf or mere teaching can be harmful.
plain_english: Recitation of a mantra that is merely written on a leaf or merely taught can bring harm.
